calls.title: Capture Higher Ed SSO Set Up
calls.summary: The team worked on completing the Single Sign-On (SSO) configuration via Azure AD, correcting the redirect URL and clarifying client ID and secret values. Scott Keller and Logan Bates handled inputting these details into Growthbook's admin portal, enabling SSO for the Capture Higher Ed domain. Testing revealed issues with client ID mismatches and caching, prompting suggestions to clear browser caches. An auto-approval setting for users with Capture Higher Ed email domains was activated, supporting quicker onboarding. Challenges with permission prompts and limited user roles were discussed, along with the need for manual role adjustments for higher permissions. Collaborative tools like screen sharing and Slack were used extensively to tackle these issues and share knowledge among team members.
calls.keywords: SSO, GrowthBook, Azure, OAuth, client ID, auto-approval
